purpose: Snapshot of the current video-production domain surface frozen at candidate 5662ede. Unlike the prior freeze (baseline 649e6fa, which recorded the legacy GenerationMode-coupled surface as current), this snapshot reflects the tree AFTER Stage A Phases 1-2 advanced: Production ISO IR and ProductionEnginePort are the canonical engine surface, and the Google Flow runtime is fully removed.

port.note: ProductionEnginePort is the canonical engine adapter contract. Takes typed IR units + artifact references; never a Flow prompt, GenerationMode, or engine SDK object.

production_ir.note: DialogueTrack value object lives ONLY in production_ir namespace (the domain package root already exports the Phase 21 audio DialogueTrack entity).

derived_artifact_contract.note: glTF = preferred asset interchange; FBX = skeletal/animation compatibility; USD = long-horizon Blender<->Unreal; .blend = derived editable artifact, NEVER source of truth.

legacy_generation_surface.GenerationMode: REMOVED from core/windagent_core/domain/video_production/enums.py (no TEXT_TO_VIDEO / IMAGE_TO_VIDEO / VIDEO_EXTENSION values remain).
legacy_generation_surface.GenerationRequest.generation_mode: field removed (grep of shot.py + enums.py returns zero generation_mode references).
legacy_generation_surface.MediaGenerationProviderPort: no longer referenced by the current engine path; legacy generative-video adapters not in the canonical tree.
legacy_generation_surface.GenerationModeDecision: no longer current; IR carries cinematic intent.

events.production_ir_additive: ProductionIrEventCatalog (video_production_ir.*) added by Phase 1; no dual-write beyond the compatibility window

storage_and_api.note: Content-addressed artifact storage (v2_artifacts) keyed by artifact hash; IR-derived artifacts reuse the same storage. API routers map canonical domain via legacy_event_mappers; no direct GenerationMode leak at the boundary.

workflow.note: Step-driven definition; composition root wired to ProductionEnginePort + IR for the 3D path (per Phase 1-2).

delta_vs_prior_snapshot.note: Prior snapshot recorded GenerationMode/FlowGenerationSpecification/GenerationModeDecision as current and marked for Phase-1 migration. This re-freeze documents that migration as EXECUTED: GenerationMode gone, IR + ProductionEnginePort present, Google Flow runtime removed.
